5 ways to stretch Kiro's free credits (credit multipliers explained)

Five ways to stretch Kiro's free credits.

1. Start on Auto - Auto costs 1x credits.
2. Cheap for routine - Qwen3 Coder Next costs 0.05x.
3. Mid-priced models - DeepSeek and MiniMax cost 0.25x.
4. Save Opus for hard bugs - Opus 5.5 costs 2x.
5. Plan before building - A good spec means fewer retries.
